requirements.description: User prefers properties near green spaces (parks, gardens). 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74.
Energy class D or better, as requested by the user. Floor area, capacity, and proximity to green spaces are not among the available columns, so they are not filtered here.

The user explicitly requires at least 600 sqm of gross floor area, so this is a direct surface_area filter. The capacity of 45 people is not converted into an area threshold because no verified gross-property-area threshold was supplied. The energy class (D or better) and proximity to green spaces are not among the reference columns and are ignored.
